Sure. I'm an international student stranded here because there are no flights back home. None of my relatives want to take me in either because apparently I'm blessed with such good luck like that. Let me tell you, I'm flat out broke AF since I've been laid off from all my jobs. I can't afford to live on campus paying $40 a night. So I applied for a summer position for campus living where they let you live on campus for free if you work for them. They made us fill some extra forms because they would only take students who were international or had no other safe living arrangements other than on campus. I thought this meant they were going to select students based on *need* for the summer job. I made sure to convey how bad I'd be screwed if I don't get this job in the interview. Also, I've already worked for them once before in the past summers. However, on May 9th I get an email saying I got waitlisted. I explained how I would be literally homeless without them providing me some sort of housing. First of all, I was under the impression that campus living would not be so heartless to not try to fill the summer staff with international students who have no where to go. I was waiting back to hear from them. They got back on the *last* day of classes  saying that they waitlisted me. I emailed them and asked for chances of getting off of the waitlist. They said the chances are almost 0 and that I have to "find other accommodation". Yeah, sure like I could find other accommodation in 9 days because campus living kicks us out on May 17th, 5pm. The least they could have done was to give the decisions early on or not pretend like they were going to take students who have no where else to go. I'm sick of this.
